target: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next single-stream HTTP/PI agent, long context; 20+ tok/s not reached

limitations: Single quick-screen run per configuration, not a statistical kernel benchmark.
File cache not flushed. First 6K request is not a fair before/after speedup basis.
Different residency changes CPU/GPU expert placement and can change generated trajectories.
Some 6K continuations stop early; compare their TTFT/rate, not total latency at unequal output lengths.
CPU compute and join/engine timings overlap; do not add nested clocks.
Previous HT-on data was not a controlled paired comparison.

experiments.name: base
experiments.disposition: baseline after hyperthreading disabled; first long prompt affected by colder file cache

experiments.name: append4
experiments.disposition: not promoted: small 14K gain but 6K TTFT regresses

experiments.name: chunk8k
experiments.disposition: rejected: lower transfers but no 14K end-to-end gain

experiments.name: keep
experiments.disposition: failed: cold microbatch exceeded retained staging; fixed by physical-capacity clamp

experiments.name: keep2
experiments.disposition: not promoted: extra 16-slot group overhead offsets reduced handoff

experiments.name: staging32
experiments.disposition: not promoted: ~3% 14K total gain, but 6K TTFT and rate regress

final_disposition: All candidates archived and removed from active source. No new production tuning flags. Earlier Server/PI/PLE changes retained.
